SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM store_sales
JOIN store ON store_sales.ss_store_sk = store.s_store_sk AND store.s_store_name = 'ese'
JOIN time_dim ON store_sales.ss_sold_time_sk = time_dim.t_time_sk
